title: Extremal 1-planar graphs without k-cliques
summary: In 2016, Dowden initiated the study of planar Turán-type problems, which has since attracted considerable attention. Recently, Bekos et al. proved that every $K_3$-free $1$-planar graph on $n\ge 4$ vertices has at most $3n-6$ edges. In this paper, we strengthen this bound to $3n - 8$, which is tight for all even $n \ge 8$. Furthermore, we show that every $K_4$-free $1$-planar graph on $n \ge 3$ vertices has at most $\bigl\lfloor \tfrac{7n}{2} \bigr\rfloor - 7$ edges, and this bound is tight for all integers $n \ge 9$. We also prove that every $K_5$-free $1$-planar graph on $n \ge 3$ vertices…
